item.description:
### Added - **Devin sessions now show up in Perch.** If you use the `devin` command-line agent, its sessions appear in the list alongside Claude Code, Codex and Cursor — with the project, the model, the session title and Devin's own logo. There's nothing to set up and nothing to turn on: Perch reads what Devin already keeps on your Mac, and changes none of it.
Devin sessions are shown as idle rather than working. Devin doesn't record anywhere Perch can read whether it's mid-task or waiting for your next prompt, so rather than guess and get it wrong, Perch shows the session without claiming it's busy. That also means no "finished" alert for Devin yet. Clicking a Devin session opens its folder rather than its terminal window, which is the next thing to fix.
Devin can't ask Perch for permission the way Claude Code and Codex do — it has no way to hand a prompt to another app — so Approve/Deny from your phone or watch doesn't apply to Devin sessions.
### Fixed - **Notifications on your phone now name the right agent.** A finished or needs-you alert from a Cursor session said "Claude Code" underneath it. Alerts on the Mac itself were always correct; this only affected the ones pushed to your phone and watch.
### Note - Update the iPhone and watch apps before, or together with, this version. An older iPhone app doesn't know about Devin yet and will label Devin sessions "Claude Code" — everything else keeps working, and the label corrects itself once the phone app updates.
